text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have plans with Maruzensky to look at
cleats together, but she's a
little late...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After failing to reach her by phone, I
decide to head to her place.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Uh, coming! Goodness, another package?!
Sorry! Just a min—hyaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear a loud noise followed by a
shout, so
I instinctively open the
door...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inside, I see Maruzensky buried under a
pile of boxes.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Sorry for startling you like that.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I love shopping online, and they send each
thing in a separate cardboard box, you
know?
I didn't even realize they'd piled up so
high.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! I haven't cleaned up at all! My whole
room's a mess of boxes!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well... I wouldn't say that.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I always tidy up pretty well when guests come over. I even get all the nooks and crannies.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But when no one visits,
I can't seem to find
the energy...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I dropped my phone in between the boxes
this morning. Then you got
there while I
was still trying to look for it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I dropped my phone in between the boxes
this morning. Then you got
there while I
was still trying to look for it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm super late, and you witnessed the mess I'm living in. Sigh... I really should try to clean more often.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wha?! You'll help? You sure?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, with you there,
I'll be all that and
a bag of chips!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, with you there,
I'll be all that and
a bag of chips!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Thanks! ♪ I appreciate it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Thanks! ♪ I appreciate it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We head back to her place and spend the
next few hours cleaning up
the
tremendous number of cardboard boxes.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer! My room looks so
much better!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer! My room looks so
much better!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Dinner's on me. Pick anything you
want—don't be shy. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll even make something from scratch if
you want. I may not seem it,
but I'm a
great cook!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Um, about as much as I clean. I just can't
be bothered when it's just
me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But today is different. You're here,
so I'm
super motivated! Japanese,
French,
Chinese, whatever you want. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But today is different. You're here,
so I'm
super motivated! Japanese,
French,
Chinese, whatever you want. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm going all out,
so I hope you brought an
appetite!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After shopping for the ingredients,
Maruzensky prepares a wonderful
dinner.
She expertly prepares and dishes out plate
after plate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks great and tastes even better.
Even
a professional chef would
be impressed!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew! That was nice. Did you like it,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Phew! That was nice. Did you like it,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm glad. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to make up for the disappointing
day this turned out to be. I
hope it wasn't
too much trouble.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to make up for the disappointing
day this turned out to be. I
hope it wasn't
too much trouble.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And it looks like I succeeded, so that's a
relief! Now there's just...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Making sure I don't let those boxes
pile up
again.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Though that's easier said than done—it
really is a pain. Cleaning is
such a hassle.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I don't hate it or anything,
but it's not the
same as running or
dancing—I can't get
into it on my own.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! How about you stop by every now
and then to check up on me?
Isn't that a
good idea?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! How about you stop by every now
and then to check up on me?
Isn't that a
good idea?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Really? How can I thank you? ...Right, how
about more home
cooking? ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Since you'll be coming over to enjoy my
food...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Since you'll be coming over to enjoy my
food...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll be motivated to keep my room tidy,
and we can enjoy eating
together!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, this is the best. The motivation, sure, but food will taste so much better now that I'm not eating alone!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: My worries are solved, and I have something to look forward to! Thank you, Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: My worries are solved, and I have something to look forward to! Thank you, Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All right, I'll be heading home now.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You know, cleaning up and eating
together...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
These are incredibly simple things,
but I'm
looking forward to them so
much, I can
barely stand it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I shouldn't be this happy needing
you to check up on the state
of my room.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's it! Maybe you should move in
next door. Then you won't
have to
commute all the way to my place. Right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I think the room next door is empty. I'll
look into it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Aw, that's too bad. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're so cute when you get all
flustered!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're so cute when you get all
flustered!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well, jokes aside... I'd be happy to have
you over anytime.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Even if it's every day. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she gets in her car and drives off,
I can
tell from her smirk that she
was teasing me.
